## 🪐 Description of Changes

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also include relevant motivation and context.

- Fixes #(issue)
- Component affected: `packages/cli` | `apps/server` | `apps/cockpit` | `apps/web` | `packages/ui`

---

## 🧪 Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] UI / Design refinement

---

## ✅ Verification Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the monorepo style guidelines and preserves strict TypeScript types.
- [ ] I have tested changes locally using `bun run build` and `bun test`.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed without errors.
- [ ] Any UI changes respect the dynamic accent theme engine (`var(--color-accent)`).
